metricName: Net incremental income earned by underserved micro-entrepreneurs
measurementFormula: Sum of verified net payouts or cost savings delivered to low-income earners
exampleTarget: $500,000 incremental annual income unlocked across 250 micro-merchants

metricName: Predatory fee dollars eliminated for underbanked users
measurementFormula: (Industry avg fee - Our transparent fee) x Transaction Volume
exampleTarget: $250,000 in hidden fees eliminated in Year 1

metricName: Metric tons of edible food waste prevented
measurementFormula: Baseline spoilage weight minus post-deployment spoilage weight
exampleTarget: 1,000 metric tons of perishable food rescued from landfill

metricName: Crop yield improvement per hectare for smallholder farms
measurementFormula: (Post-tool harvest kg/ha - Baseline kg/ha) / Baseline kg/ha
exampleTarget: +18% average yield lift across 500 monitored acres

metricName: Clinician administrative hours returned to direct patient care
measurementFormula: Verified admin hours automated per active clinic x active clinics
exampleTarget: 10,000 clinician hours returned to patients in 12 months

metricName: Median days reduced from symptom/screening to verified care
measurementFormula: Regional baseline wait time minus platform median time-to-care
exampleTarget: 14 days faster time-to-treatment across 2,000 patients

metricName: Learners achieving verified job-ready mastery or certification
measurementFormula: Count of unique learners passing proctored/project assessments
exampleTarget: 5,000 learners placed into higher-skill roles in 18 months

metricName: Educator prep & grading hours saved per week
measurementFormula: Verified weekly hours saved per active teacher x active teachers
exampleTarget: 5 hours/week returned to 1,000 public school educators

metricName: Pay-gap or hiring-bias discrepancies detected and resolved
